api/index.title: API Reference
api/index.description: This section documents the key interfaces and classes in the Modulus framework.

architecture/clean-architecture.title: Clean Architecture
architecture/clean-architecture.description: Each Modulus module follows a 4-layer Clean Architecture layout:

architecture/module-system.title: Module System
architecture/module-system.description: Modules are the fundamental building blocks of a Modulus application. Each module encapsulates a business domain with its own data, logic, and API surface.

architecture/overview.title: Architecture Overview
architecture/overview.description: Modulus follows a modular-monolith architecture — a single deployable application composed of independent business modules with clear boundaries.

architecture/service-lifecycle.title: Service Lifecycle
architecture/service-lifecycle.description: Modulus modules go through a well-defined lifecycle from discovery to shutdown.

cli/add-module.title: modulus add-module
cli/add-module.description: Adds a layered module to an existing Modulus application.

cli/app.title: modulus app
cli/app.description: Creates a complete modular-monolith application with interactive setup.

cli/doctor.title: modulus doctor
cli/doctor.description: Checks the development environment for issues.

cli/generate-command.title: modulus generate-command
cli/generate-command.description: Generates a single command and handler.

cli/generate-crud.title: modulus generate-crud
cli/generate-crud.description: Generates complete CRUD operations for an entity.

cli/generate-query.title: modulus generate-query
cli/generate-query.description: Generates a single query and handler.

cli/global-flags.title: Global Flags
cli/global-flags.description: All CLI commands support these flags.

cli/index.title: CLI Reference
cli/index.description: The modulus CLI tool generates complete solutions, modules, and CRUD code.

cli/info.title: modulus info
cli/info.description: Shows an overview of the application.

cli/list.title: modulus list
cli/list.description: Lists all modules and their entities.

cli/migrate.title: modulus migrate
cli/migrate.description: Database migration commands. Works with both EF Core and dbsh engines.

cli/outdated.title: modulus outdated
cli/outdated.description: Shows all packages with newer versions available on NuGet.

cli/templates.title: Templates
cli/templates.description: The CLI uses Scriban templates embedded as resources.

cli/update.title: modulus update
cli/update.description: Updates packages to their latest versions with backup and rollback support.

configuration/appsettings.title: appsettings.json
configuration/appsettings.description: Modulus apps use a hierarchical configuration system.

configuration/build-system.title: Build System
configuration/build-system.description: Modulus uses MSBuild with centralized configuration.

configuration/central-package-management.title: Central Package Management
configuration/central-package-management.description: Modulus uses NuGet Central Package Management (CPM) for dependency version control.

data/entity-framework.title: Entity Framework Core
data/entity-framework.description: Modulus integrates deeply with EF Core for relational database access.

data/migrations.title: Migrations
data/migrations.description: Modulus supports two migration engines: EF Core (default) and dbsh (SQL-first).

data/mongodb.title: MongoDB
data/mongodb.description: Modulus supports MongoDB as an alternative to relational databases.

data/overview.title: Data Layer Overview
data/overview.description: Modulus provides a flexible data access layer supporting relational databases (via EF Core) and MongoDB.

data/repositories.title: Repositories
data/repositories.description: Modulus uses the Repository pattern to abstract data access.

deployment.title: Deployment
deployment.description: Modulus applications deploy as a single process.

features.title: Framework Features
features.description: Modulus provides a comprehensive set of features for building scalable, production-ready modular-monolith applications.

getting-started/first-module.title: First Module
getting-started/first-module.description: This guide walks you through creating a business module with CRUD operations.

hardening/correlation.title: Request Correlation
hardening/correlation.description: Modulus provides automatic correlation ID propagation across services.

hardening/cors.title: CORS
hardening/cors.description: Modulus provides CORS configuration with wildcard-subdomain awareness.

hardening/feature-flags.title: Feature Flags
hardening/feature-flags.description: Modulus integrates Microsoft.FeatureManagement for feature toggling.

hardening/health-checks.title: Health Checks
hardening/health-checks.description: Modulus provides liveness and readiness health probes.

hardening/idempotency.title: HTTP Idempotency
hardening/idempotency.description: Modulus provides idempotency for unsafe (mutating) HTTP endpoints.

hardening/personal-data-protection.title: Personal Data Protection
hardening/personal-data-protection.description: Modulus provides transparent at-rest encryption of designated personal data columns.

hardening/rate-limiting.title: Rate Limiting
hardening/rate-limiting.description: Modulus provides built-in rate limiting partitioned by user, tenant, IP, or globally.

hardening/secrets-guard.title: Secrets Guard
hardening/secrets-guard.description: A startup guard that fails fast when secrets are found in committed configuration files.

hardening/security-headers.title: Security Headers
hardening/security-headers.description: Modulus adds security headers to all responses.

identity/external-providers.title: External Providers
identity/external-providers.description: Modulus supports 6 external identity providers with local token validation.

identity/openiddict.title: OpenIddict
identity/openiddict.description: OpenIddict provides the OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect server.

identity/overview.title: Identity Overview
identity/overview.description: Modulus provides authentication and authorization via OpenIddict with support for 6 external identity providers.

messaging/events.title: Events
messaging/events.description: Modulus supports two types of events: domain events and integration events.

messaging/inbox.title: Inbox
messaging/inbox.description: The inbox pattern provides idempotent message consumption — ensuring each integration event is processed exactly once.

messaging/kafka.title: Kafka
messaging/kafka.description: Modulus integrates with Apache Kafka for high-throughput event streaming.

messaging/mediator.title: Mediator
messaging/mediator.description: The mediator implements the CQRS pattern with command/query separation and pipeline behaviors.

messaging/outbox.title: Outbox
messaging/outbox.description: The transactional outbox pattern ensures reliable event publishing by storing events in the database within the same transaction as business data.

messaging/overview.title: Messaging Overview
messaging/overview.description: Modulus provides a complete messaging stack for event-driven architecture within the monolith.

messaging/rabbitmq.title: RabbitMQ
messaging/rabbitmq.description: Modulus integrates with RabbitMQ for cross-service event delivery.

observability/opentelemetry.title: OpenTelemetry
observability/opentelemetry.description: Modulus integrates with OpenTelemetry for distributed tracing and metrics.

observability/overview.title: Observability Overview
observability/overview.description: Modulus provides built-in observability via OpenTelemetry.

platform/authorization.title: Authorization
platform/authorization.description: Modulus provides a permission-based authorization system.

platform/background-jobs.title: Background Jobs
platform/background-jobs.description: Modulus provides an in-process background job system with optional Quartz.NET integration.

platform/caching.title: Caching
platform/caching.description: Modulus provides in-memory caching with tag-based invalidation.

platform/multi-tenancy.title: Multi-Tenancy
platform/multi-tenancy.description: Modulus provides built-in multi-tenant data isolation.

platform/overview.title: Platform Services Overview
platform/overview.description: Modulus.Platform provides cross-cutting concerns for multi-tenant applications.

platform/signalr.title: SignalR
platform/signalr.description: Modulus provides real-time communication via SignalR.

platform/storage.title: Storage
platform/storage.description: Modulus provides file storage abstraction with local and cloud providers.

testing/integration-tests.title: Integration Tests
testing/integration-tests.description: Modulus provides ModulusWebAppFactory for HTTP-based integration testing.

testing/overview.title: Testing Overview
testing/overview.description: Modulus provides a comprehensive testing harness.
